titulo: The evening: aperitivo, the round, and how to leave a table
subtitulo: Aperitivo is not dinner and not a happy hour — knowing which it is decides whether you eat at nine
cena: A glass has arrived with a plate of things next to it and you cannot tell whether this is a snack or the meal.
frasePiso: Ask what comes with it, decide whether it replaces dinner, and leave the table with a sentence instead of a wave.
decisao: decidir se o aperitivo é o jantar ou a entrada dele antes de pedir a segunda rodada, porque isso muda o resto da noite

steps.pt: The Italian evening has a step before dinner. A drink, something to eat with it, and a decision about whether that is the whole meal.

steps.acao: Ask what comes with it before ordering the second one.
steps.es: Facciamo l'aperitivo? Qui viene con il buffet.
steps.pt: Shall we do aperitivo? Here it comes with the buffet.
steps.tts: Facciamo l'aperitivo? Qui viene con il buffet.

steps.promptPt: Say yes and ask what comes with the drink. Speak now.

steps.pt: That question decides the night. If a buffet is included, this is dinner. If it is olives and crisps, dinner is still coming at nine.

steps.promptPt: Ask the price of the aperitivo, using the frame from B11. Speak now.
Order the classic one and let them choose which. Speak now.

steps.pt: Something without alcohol is completely ordinary at this hour. Analcolico is the word, and nobody blinks.

steps.promptPt: Ask whether there is something non-alcoholic, using the frame from B08. Speak now.

steps.pt: Now the round. Offering to pay for everyone is normal, and so is being firmly refused the first time.

steps.promptPt: Offer to get this round. Speak now.

steps.acao: Insist once, then let it go. Twice is generous, three times is a fight.
steps.es: Ma no, ci mancherebbe. Offro io, siete ospiti.
steps.pt: Absolutely not. It's on me, you're guests.
steps.tts: Ma no, ci mancherebbe. Offro io, siete ospiti.

steps.promptPt: Concede gracefully and claim the next one. Speak now.
steps.es: Va bene, ma il prossimo lo offro io.
steps.pinyin: va BEH-ne, ma eel PROS-see-mo lo OF-fro EE-o
steps.pt: All right, but the next one is on me.
steps.tts: Va bene, ma il prossimo lo offro io.

steps.promptPt: Ask where they eat afterwards — the recommendation you actually want. Speak now.
steps.es: Dopo, dove si va a mangiare?
steps.pinyin: DO-po, DO-ve see va a man-JA-re
steps.pt: Afterwards, where does one go to eat?
steps.tts: Dopo, dove si va a mangiare?

steps.promptPt: It is time to go. Leave the table properly instead of drifting off. Speak now.
steps.pt: We're heading off, thank you for the company.

steps.es: Volentieri. Cosa c'è compreso? Questo giro lo offro io. Noi andiamo, grazie della compagnia.
steps.pinyin: vo-len-TYE-ri. KO-za cheh kom-PRE-zo. KWES-to JEE-ro lo OF-fro EE-o. noy an-DYA-mo GRA-tsee-eh DEL-la kom-pa-NYEE-a
steps.pt: Shadow the evening: accept, check, offer, leave.
steps.tts: Volentieri. Cosa c'è compreso? Questo giro lo offro io. Noi andiamo, grazie della compagnia.

steps.pt: I04 done. Cosa c'è compreso decides whether you eat again, and grazie della compagnia is how a table is left.

secoes.titulo: Aperitivo is a time, not a menu
secoes.corpo: Roughly from six or seven until dinner. The drink has a fixed price and what comes with it varies enormously by city and by bar — from a bowl of crisps to a buffet you can build a meal from.

secoes.titulo: The buffet version is a Milanese habit
secoes.corpo: The generous spread is properly called apericena — a word Treccani defines as an aperitivo with enough food to replace dinner. It is a northern coinage from the late nineties and it is strongest in Milan. That it stays smaller in the south is what everyone says and what no survey measures, so treat it as a tendency rather than a border.

Offering is expected; being refused the first time is also expected. Insist once, and if it is refused again, take the next round instead. Splitting a bar tab item by item is unusual and slightly cold.
Drifting away from an Italian table reads as something having gone wrong. Noi andiamo, grazie della compagnia takes two seconds and closes the evening cleanly for everyone still sitting.

permissao: You are allowed to order something without alcohol at aperitivo hour and to sit at the table for two hours over one drink. Neither of those is a failure to participate — the point of the hour is the sitting, and the bar is not counting your glasses.
espelho: Anyone who has stayed for a second drink they did not want because leaving felt abrupt knows the second half of this part. The exit sentence exists precisely so that going home early stops requiring an excuse.

fichasCulturais.sinal: You order an aperitivo and food starts arriving that you did not order and were not told about.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: I am being served things I will be charged for.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: At aperitivo hour the food that comes with the drink is included in its price. The drink costs more than the same drink at noon precisely because of what arrives beside it.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Ask cosa c'è compreso? when you order, so you know whether this is a snack or the meal, and plan dinner accordingly.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You either stop looking for a restaurant at nine or you stop filling up on a buffet an hour before dinner — both of which are decided by one question.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not a rule that everything on the counter is free — in some places the buffet is a separate paid item, and the size of what is included varies sharply between north and south.

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Aperitivo is a large, measured market: FIPE-Confcommercio, on TradeLab data, counts 14 million Italians, 507 million evening aperitivi a year and about EUR 4 billion of spending, down 3.2% from 2024 to 2025; aperitivo accounts for 14% of all bar visits. Price varies enormously by city — a 2025 survey of Aperol Spritz found Milan EUR 10.33 against Naples EUR 2.00, with Rome EUR 7.00 and Venice EUR 4.50.
fatosDatados.fonte: FIPE-Confcommercio / TradeLab — «Come sta cambiando l'aperitivo», 12 maggio 2026; idealo — rilevazione prezzi Aperol Spritz 2025

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Apericena is a distinct format, not a synonym for aperitivo: the Treccani dictionary defines it as an aperitivo served with a rich series of snacks and tastings of savoury and sweet dishes «which can be consumed in place of dinner». It is a northern, Milanese coinage from the late 1990s and the word itself is treated as a neologism. The claim that the format stays smaller in the south is widely asserted but not quantified in any survey found.
fatosDatados.fonte: Vocabolario Treccani — «apericena»; Libreriamo — «origine della parola macedonia»
